item.title: LiteDB will let you put [BsonId] on the wrong property
item.description: LiteDB doesn't warn you when [BsonId] lands on a property that isn't the id. It builds a phantom unique index instead, every document indexes as null, and the second insert dies on a key you never wrote. What's going on, why a corrected build kept failing anyway, and the pattern I use now.
